reports.title: Riskified Reports Strong Third Quarter of 2026 with Accelerating Revenue and Gross Profit Growth

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: We now anticipate revenue to be between $427 million and $433 million, or $430 million at the midpoint, up from our prior range of between $400 million and $410 million. This reflects the flow-through of our third quarter revenue outperformance, as well as an incremental raise to our outlook based on the momentum we are seeing in the business.
We now anticipate Adjusted EBITDA to be between $39 million and $43 million, or $41 million at the midpoint, up from our prior range of $33 million to $39 million.

The primary factors that may determine where we fall within each range are the timing and ramping of new merchant go-lives and existing merchant upsells, our success in retaining our merchants, and the broader macro environment.

desk.headline: Revenue up 41% to $115.2m, beat; adjusted EPS $0.07 beat; 2026 revenue and EBITDA outlook raised
results: Revenue jumped 41% to $115.2m, well above the $103.4m estimate and faster than Q2's 22% growth.
Growth came mainly from new merchants; billings from digital finance clients more than quadrupled.
Gross margin fell to 43% from 50%, as newly signed merchants carry higher fraud losses early on.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 47% to $8.1m and the GAAP net loss shrank to $1.3m from $7.8m.
Free cash flow was a record $15.2m; cash and investments were about $234.9m with no debt.

guidance.summary: Riskified raised its 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA ranges for the third time this year, citing Q3 outperformance and business momentum.

points: New merchants drove growth; US revenue grew about 69%, up from 38% in Q2.
Management expects older merchant groups to keep improving and offset weaker margins on new ones into 2027.
New tools to spot fraud by automated shopping assistants, plus a customer-service tie-up with Zendesk, target a growing risk area.
Buybacks slowed in Q3 to keep cash flexible; acquisitions are being studied.
Gross profit growth outlook raised to 14–16%; 2027 guidance will come with Q4 results.
